summary: Spacious first floor two bedroom apartment. Located in the Parkside area of Darlington, within walking distance to the town centre and with easy access to the A66/A1. You enter the property via a flight of stairs to the first floor, landing area, bright and airy living room with space for a table and chairs. Fully fitted kitchen with a range of wall and base units. Two double bedrooms, family bathroom with white suite and shower over the bath. Private rear garden, driveway to the front aspect. 120 Year Lease. Service Charge/Ground Rent £12.68 per month.
